LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Enlist_Letter_Label: The colony is now in a treethane's service. Bosmer hunters will share meat and coin with you, and expect you not to cut their trees.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Enlist_Button_Desc: Take service with a treethane of Valenwood. Mind the Green Pact and you will do fine.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Enlist_Requrements_Not_S: The treethanes have not warmed to you. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Fact: No treethane will take the pledge of an enemy of Valenwood.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Missions_Desc: See what the treethane wants done.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Menu_Missions_Desc: Errands from the treethane's hall. Paid when finished, and paid fairly.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Provisions_Desc: Meat from the treethane's hunters. Nothing green, of course.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in the hollow of a graht-oak.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Resign_Menu_Text: Break your pledge to the treethane? The Bosmer will not forget it.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony has left the treethane's service.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Resign_Button_Desc: End your service to the treethane.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The treethanes want nothing more to do with the colony.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Salary_Desc: A share of the treethane's trade.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Work_0_Desc: Bring down game in the deep forest with Bosmer archers.
LanguageData.ESCP_Treethanes_Work_1_Desc: Watch for woodcutters and anyone else foolish enough to bring an axe.
